title: CAMÕES: A Comprehensive Automatic Speech Recognition Benchmark for European Portuguese

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the Word Error Rate (WER) of Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models across different regional varieties of Portuguese, specifically European, Brazilian, African, and Asian Portuguese, to evaluate performance disparities caused by under-representation in training data.
Evaluating and comparing ASR model performance (Word Error Rate) across multiple distinct speaker age ranges, from young children (ages 3-6) to elderly speakers (ages 86+).
Measuring and comparing the Word Error Rate (WER) of ASR models on speech samples from male versus female speakers to assess demographic performance balance.
